description: Talk to a thread's agent hands-free, like ChatGPT or Codex voice. When the composer is empty its send button becomes a waveform; click it for a full-duplex realtime voice chat. The voice model hands requests to the thread's agent, answers "is it done?", stops the agent when you say stop, and reads back a short summary when the turn ends. Talk over it any time to interrupt. Uses OpenAI Realtime with your own API key, or a plugin that provides realtime connections (for example a company AI proxy). Relies on bb's composer markup, so a bb update can hide the waveform until the plugin catches up; bb's own send and dictation are never affected.
